title: Network Boot illustration pack for Private/VPC installs and upgrade flows
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal:
Produce a compact, reusable illustration asset pack and a small set of product screenshots to support the Private/VPC onboarding flow and the in-app upgrade UI. Assets must work in both docs (Confluence) and the Console (React). Target audiences: platform engineers (primary) and product engineers/DevOps (secondary).

Scope & deliverables:
- Network flow diagram: single-page, color-coded diagram that shows customer VPC, subnets, NAT, load balancer, and Redwood private nodes. Provide one cross-region and one single-region variant. Export as SVG + PNG (3 sizes).
- Install step illustrations: 6 step vignettes to match the 'Network Boot' guided flow (prepare network, open ports, configure routes, apply infra template, verify health, finalise). Each vignette: flat icons + short caption.
- Live CLI step mockups: two screenshot-style images showing the CLI bootstrap running with success/failure states. Include an 'overlay validator' callout for CIDR overlap warnings.
- Upgrade UI callout: three states for the upgrade modal/banner: Available, In-Progress, Blocked (with checklist of node-level blockers). Provide motion spec for subtle progress shimmer.
- Migration assistant panel: a narrow UI card that summarizes automatic config changes and rollback button — design in both light/dark tokens.
- One-page quick reference: 'What to expect during installation' illustrated card for docs.

Constraints & technical notes:
- Engineering (ENG-3048) requires assets to be exportable as accessible SVGs (labels must be selectable text), and Console screenshot variants must match the Redwood design tokens.
- CIDR validator messaging must match the string in ENG-3059; design must allow for variable-length warning copy.
- Security asked to include a small KMS flow inset showing where keys are referenced (KMS arrows must be neutral color).

Design decisions and trade-offs considered:
- Inline animated SVGs vs static PNG: we will produce static PNGs for docs and an optional animated SVG for the Console where performance is acceptable. Trade-off: animations improve clarity but increase bundle size; will gate via feature flag.
- Minimalist vs detailed topology diagram: chosen a medium-fidelity diagram so it is readable by non-network-engineers while still useful for SREs.

Acceptance criteria (what 'done' looks like):
- All assets uploaded to Figma file and exported to Drive in required formats (SVG, PNG @1x/2x).
- Console screenshot mocks implemented in a small Storybook story for review by ENG.
- Upgrade UI motion spec documented in Confluence and linked to PR.
- PM and Security sign-off recorded in comments.

Notes for engineering handoff:
- Include a CSV with copy strings used in validator and upgrade modal so ENG doesn't hardcode wording.
- Provide an example of the CLI output used in screenshot (sanitized).

Links to reference artifacts and inspiration are in attachments.
